caption_L1: Top 15 Jobs in the U.S. with the highest divorce rate based on 2000 U.S. Census data is a bar chart. Divorce rate is drawn using a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4 on the y-axis. There is a categorical scale with Baggage porters and concierges on one end and Waiters/Waitresses at the other along the x-axis, labeled profession.
caption_L2L3: Dancers and Choreographers had the highest divorce rate in the year 2000 among the top 15 jobs in the US at just over 0.4. Clearly second and third highest were bartenders and Massage Therapists. The lowest divorce rate was Maids and housekeeping cleaners closely followed by roofers and waiters or waitresses.
